# style-guide

A request, an error, a queue, a worker, a lease, and an idempotency entry are vocabulary used in this style-guide.
The retry lease expired wording is an example label; this file supplies no diagnosis or handling rule.
This style-guide is weak evidence for incident handling and contains no complete diagnostic.
